package unit

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/infrastructure/logging"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
	pkglog "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/pkg/log"
)

type stubSink struct {
	events []domain.Event
	err    error
}

func (s *stubSink) Publish(_ context.Context, ev domain.Event) error {
	if s.err != nil {
		return s.err
	}
	s.events = append(s.events, ev)
	return nil
}

func TestStartSession(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &stubSink{}
	logger := testLogger()
	service := usecase.NewEventService(sink, logger)

	meta := usecase.RequestMeta{UserID: uuid.New(), Role: "student"}
	req := usecase.SessionStartRequest{
		CourseID:   uuid.New(),
		LessonID:   uuid.New(),
		TaskID:     uuid.New(),
		Platform:   "web",
		EditorMode: "html",
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"user_agent": "test",
		},
	}

	resp, err := service.StartSession(context.Background(), meta, req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if resp.SessionID == uuid.Nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected session id to be set")
	}
	if len(sink.events) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected event to be published")
	}
	ev := sink.events[0]
	if ev.EventType != domain.EventTypeSessionStart {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected event type: %s", ev.EventType)
	}
	if ev.UserID != meta.UserID || ev.Role != meta.Role {
		t.Fatalf("user context not propagated")
	}
}

func TestPublishBatch(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &stubSink{}
	logger := testLogger()
	service := usecase.NewEventService(sink, logger)

	meta := usecase.RequestMeta{UserID: uuid.New(), Role: "student"}
	root := usecase.EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID:   uuid.New(),
		LessonID:   uuid.New(),
		TaskID:     uuid.New(),
		Platform:   "web",
		EditorMode: "html",
		Events: []usecase.IncomingEvent{
			{
				SessionID: uuid.New(),
				EventType: domain.EventTypeKeyPress,
				Payload: map[string]any{
					"key": "a",
				},
			},
		},
	}

	accepted, err := service.PublishBatch(context.Background(), meta, root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
	if accepted != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 accepted, got %d", accepted)
	}
	if len(sink.events) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 event in sink")
	}
	ev := sink.events[0]
	if ev.Platform != "web" || ev.EditorMode != "html" {
		t.Fatalf("expected platform/editor_mode propagated")
	}
}

func TestPublishBatchRejectsUnknownEventType(t *testing.T) {
	sink := &stubSink{}
	logger := testLogger()
	service := usecase.NewEventService(sink, logger)

	meta := usecase.RequestMeta{UserID: uuid.New(), Role: "student"}
	root := usecase.EventsBatchRequest{
		CourseID:   uuid.New(),
		LessonID:   uuid.New(),
		TaskID:     uuid.New(),
		Platform:   "web",
		EditorMode: "html",
		Events: []usecase.IncomingEvent{
			{
				SessionID: uuid.New(),
				EventType: "unknown",
				Payload:   map[string]any{},
			},
		},
	}

	if _, err := service.PublishBatch(context.Background(), meta, root); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected error for unknown event type")
	}
}

func testLogger() logging.ZerologErrorLogger {
	return logging.NewZerologErrorLogger(pkglog.New("test"))
}
